Name: Bomb
Description: Big area damage. Hurts both Castles.

Name: Missile
Description: Huge area damage. Hurts both Castles.

Name: Nuke
Description: Massive area damage. Hurts both Castles.

Name: Water Gun
Description: Snipes a single target for big damage and knockback.

Name: Rifle
Description: Snipes a single target for huge damage and knockback.

Name: Sniper Rifle
Description: Perfectly headshots a single target for massive damage and knockback.

Name: Fire Bomb
Description: Sets the ground on fire burning units and damaging over time.

Name: Mega Fire Bomb
Description: Sets the ground on fire. Super hot blue flames deal extra damage over time.

Name: Inferno Wall
Description: Sets the ground on fire. The hottest white flames deal massive damage over time.

Name: Freeze Ray
Description: Freezes all enemy units for a short time.

Name: Turbo Freeze Ray
Description: Freezes all enemy units.

Name: Arctic Blast
Description: Deep freezes all enemy units. Turbo freeze is so cold that units remain slowed even after they thaw.

Name: Team Heal
Description: Heals all allied units over time.

Name: Mega Team Heal
Description: Heals all allied units a large amount over time.

Name: Mass Healing
Description: Heals all allied units a massive amount over time.

Name: The Wall
Description: Spawns a protective wall in front of your castle.

Name: The Big Wall
Description: Spawns a larger wall. Can be targeted anywhere on the map.

Name: The Biggest Wall
Description: Spawns an nearly impenetrable barrier, blocking all enemies.

Name: Speed Boost
Description: Boosts speed of all allied units.

Name: Mega Speed Boost
Description: Significantly boosts speed of all allied units.

Name: Turbo Speed Boost
Description: Boosts speed of all allied units to the max!

Name: Reinforcements
Description: Spawns 5 reinforcement units.

Name: Reinforcements
Description: Spawns 5 strong reinforcement units.

Name: Reinforcements
Description: Spawns 5 of the strongest reinforcement units.

Name: Cash Drop
Description: Air drops a quick cash injection.

Name: Mega Cash Drop
Description: Air drops a large crate of cash.

Name: Raining Cash
Description: Crates of cash rain from the sky for the next 10 seconds!

Name: Rage
Description: Works all units up into a rage, boosting damage.

Name: Rage
Description: Works all units up into a seething rage, boosting damage significantly.

Name: Rage
Description: Works all units up into a furious rage, becoming so angry they deal 10x their regular damage!

Name: Goo Ball
Description: Spills goo on the field. Heals allies and slows enemies

Name: Big Goo Ball
Description: Spills goo on the field in a large area. Heals allies even more and slows enemies

Name: Huge Goo Ball
Description: Covers the entire map in goo! Heals allies significantly and slows enemies

Name: Poison Gas
Description: Spawns a poison cloud, dealing damage over time.

Name: Noxious Gas
Description: Spawns a dangerous poison cloud, dealing big damage over time.

Name: Toxic Gas
Description: Spawns a huge cloud of the most powerful poison, melting all enemy health bars!

Name: Shield
Description: Provides a shield to all allied units. Absorbing damage and preventing knockback.

Name: Big Shield
Description: Provides a large shield to all allied units. Absorbing damage and preventing knockback.

Name: Divine Shield
Description: Calls to the gods for divine intervention. Blessing your castle and all allied units with complete invulnerability!

Name: Meteor Strike
Description: Calls down a meteor from the sky, dealing damage to enemy units and setting them on fire.

Name: Mega Meteor Strike
Description: Calls down multiple huge meteors, dealing big damage to enemy units and setting them on fire.

Name: Meteor Shower
Description: Brings forth a deadly meteor shower to pummel the enemy forces!

Name: Wave
Description: Sends a wave across the map to the opposing castle, pushing all enemies back.

Name: Tidal Wave
Description: Sends a huge wave across the map to the opposing castle, pushing all enemies back even farther.

Name: Tsunami
Description: A massive tsunami crashes towards the enemy castle, sending all but the most powerful units flying backwards!

Name: Black Hole
Description: Creates a black hole on the field that pulls in and damages all units

Name: Massive Black Hole
Description: Creates a giant black hole on the field that pulls in and damages all units

Name: Supermassive Black Hole
Description: Summons a supermassive black hole that pulls in everything around it! All but the most powerful units are instantly annihilated!
